Subject: Flowline deal — MAP + SOW draft for S2CS transfer

Olga —

Congrats on the close yesterday. Quick handoff notes so CS has the context when they pick this up:

- ARR: $420k annual commit (multi-region pilot in US-east then US-west).
- Primary contact: Samir Patel (PO) — samir@flowline.io. CC'd.
- Target go-live window: mid-July but they want a phased pilot starting with a 2-week POC in June.
- Key constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data flows (no PHI in hosted logging), procurement needs a customer-managed KMS for Private deployment.

Attached: mutual action plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a first-pass SOW (SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf). I highlighted the milestones we agreed on (column D in MAP).

Asks for CS / Ops:
1) Nominate a primary steward who will own the onboarding and acceptance criteria.
2) Confirm estimated engineering effort and a tentative kickoff date for the sprint0 intake.
3) Verify whether the Private deployment + KMS ask will require an extended procurement path — procurement lead is expecting a doc they can reference.

Marissa, Karthik: loop in any runbook templates or technical intake forms you want Olga to prep before the kickoff.

Olga — you should have HubSpot deal FLOW-2029-089 with the artifact links (https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/FLOW-2029-089).

Thanks — Ben

Ben Carter

Subject: Re: Flowline deal — MAP + SOW draft for S2CS transfer

Thanks for the note — adding a few technical acceptance points so CS can bake them into the checklist:

Acceptance / gating criteria (technical):
- Private deploy validated: customer-managed KMS integration complete and end-to-end encryption keys verified in staging. (Owner: SE)
- Token throughput verified for 95th percentile traffic in pilot (Owner: SE + Infra).
- No logging of raw user content in hosted telemetry; only aggregated metrics allowed (Owner: CS/Privacy).
- API contract and sample payloads accepted by Flowline devs (Owner: Flowline dev + SE).
- Rollback plan defined for model variant fallbacks and capacity outages (Owner: Infra + CS).

Phased rollout proposal:
- Phase 0 (POC, 2 weeks): limited feature set, test dataset, staging with Private deploy KMS stub.
- Phase 1 (Pilot, 6 weeks): live traffic for a single product line, 1–2M tokens/week.
- Phase 2 (Scale): multi-region routing and SLA handoff.

I've uploaded a deployment checklist (deployment_checklist.csv) with the above gates and estimated owner assignments. Olga — I'll leave the kickoff tech agenda and invite time slots for May 16/17.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: deployment_checklist.csv (CSV checklist)

Subject: Re: Flowline deal — MAP + SOW draft for S2CS transfer

Thanks all — appreciate the clear plan. A couple of clarifications from Flowline: 

- Go-live window: mid-July still feasible but we prefer an initial pilot start date of 2029-06-10 if the POC can be in place. That will help our product team validate the connector.
- KMS: we will provide customer-managed keys; procurement needs a short integration spec for our security team (SOC2 evidence is also requested). Can you confirm where Redwood will host the key handling instructions? A doc link would be great.
- Acceptance: for the POC, we only need the Private deploy, API contract acceptance and the no-raw-logging guarantee. The throughput numbers listed look fine.

Olga — please route the procurement ask to your security lead and share the integration spec + evidence bundle (SOC2 cert + controls summary). We can sign off on the POC once those are received.

Samir Patel
Director, Product Operations | Flowline Health
samir@flowline.io | +1 (617) 555-7764

Forwarded attachments: none. Requested: SOC2 summary, KMS integration spec.
